meta.description: Full-stack developer. Online stores, custom systems and automation for growing businesses, built with enterprise-grade tech.

hero.intro: I build web applications and internal systems.
hero.introSecondary: I work with clients in Argentina, Europe and the United States.

bioMore.p1: I'm a full-stack developer focused on product: React, Next.js, TypeScript, and the subscription and AI integration work I've been building lately for clients in Europe and the US.
bioMore.p2pre: Outside of client work, I play guitar in
bioMore.p2post: , a band from Córdoba blending shoegaze, trip-hop, and Argentine folk, and I build sim racing tools as a technical hobby — everything from race data analysis to computer-vision camera control.

about.label: About
intro: I'm interested in building products that actually solve something. I work closely with teams because understanding how they operate is what lets me bring my own ideas to the table, instead of just executing decisions that were already made — often what's missing is someone who knows what's technically possible.
about.introBandPre: Outside of client work I play guitar in
about.introBandPost: . I also race in the simulator, and that's where a couple of tools I built for myself came from — I wanted to see how far it could go.

timeline.detail: Technical lead for the digital presence of a European hostel chain: maintaining and developing their three WordPress sites, managing domains and infrastructure, and building their two new products — the membership portal and the internal management platform.
Developer, free of charge, for the Student Affairs Office at FCS – UNC, building the online enrollment platform for the faculty's Working Student regime.
Developer at Mully Group, focused on the company's Shopify store and its two US golf products, Greens Club and the membership platform.

A short contract at an agency. Among the projects, I built a custom WordPress plugin for a client: a PDF catalogue generator driven by the products in WooCommerce, styled to the brand and with configurable per-category filters to produce catalogues tailored to whichever client requested one.

Contractor at a Spanish agency with its own client base. Maintenance of several WordPress sites, most of them on WooCommerce, and migration of sites built on older technologies into the WordPress ecosystem. It was my first time working deeply with PHP, editing backend functions across several projects at once.

Work for direct clients —among them the agency Itserra and Bastian Viana— plus a real-estate listings portal for the Andorran market. The focus here was infrastructure: server setup and administration, migrations, and resource optimisation, on top of WordPress and WooCommerce.
